user.title: LG AC Infrared
user.description: Choose the infrared emitter that transmits to your LG air conditioner. This is typically an ESPHome device running the `ir_rf_proxy` component.

abort.no_emitters: No infrared emitter entities were found. Set up an infrared emitter first (for example, an ESPHome device with the `ir_rf_proxy` component), then add this integration.
abort.already_configured: This infrared emitter already has an LG AC configured.
